_about: 787-9, from Boeing D6-58333 Rev Q 2.2.2 (page index 21): side, plan and front views on one sheet, a picture rather than vector paths (about 47 px a meter at scale 8, so outlines good to about 3 cm). Line centres. Scaled by the printed 62.81 m overall length from the nose to the tail cone's tip in the side view (2978): with that scale the drawing's doors land within 0.1 m of the door-location table (2.7.1). Door 3 is hidden behind the wing in the drawing and is placed from that table (35.43 m to its centre). The windows behind the wing's lines are placed at the drawing's own pitch (windowsAlso).

sources.title: Boeing, 787 Airplane Characteristics for Airport Planning (D6-58333 Rev Q, October 2025), 2.2.2 General Dimensions: Model 787-9; 2.7.1 Door Locations
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off the side, plan and front views (tools/trace/b789/); the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. The sheet is a picture of about 47 pixels a meter, so the outlines are good to about 3 cm. The drawing shows the cabin windows; those behind the wing's lines, and door 3 (placed from the door-location table), are hidden there.
